title: Privacy-preserving occupancy counting across overlapping sensors
abstract: Sensors send counts, not images; a controller subtracts the overlap count.
description: Each sensor processes its frames locally and transmits only a count of persons and a count of persons inside a predefined overlap region. A room controller computes the room count as the sum of the sensor counts minus the overlap count. Each sensor updates its background only while no motion has been detected for a holding period.

claims.text: A method of counting occupants of a room monitored by a first sensor and a second sensor with an overlap region, comprising: at each sensor, counting persons locally and counting persons within the overlap region; transmitting only the counts; and computing a room count as the sum of the counts minus the overlap count.
The method of claim 1, wherein each sensor updates a background estimate only while no motion has been detected for a holding period.
